changelog:
film-pipeline v1.0.0

- Initial release of a centralized film creation skill, acting as a workflow controller for script, character, action, and trailer generation
- Automatically analyzes user intent and dispatches tasks to four sub-skills: character-sheet, storyboard-9grid, action-director, and trailer-director
- Ensures full-process consistency in visual style, characters, and scenes
- Supports flexible, multi-step pipelines and single-task routing based on user input
- Integrates outputs from all sub-skills, checks style coherence, and provides next-step suggestions
